name: Object Tracking (identity across frames)
purpose: Associate per-frame object detections (the detect.objects #16 output shape: each detection {class, class_id, score, box{x,y,width,height}}) into stable identity tracks so the same object keeps ONE track_id across a sequence of sampled frames. TWO modes. -Mode stable (DEFAULT, 0.2.0, per the folded frontier design review research/2026-07-30-track-objects-design-review.md): a deterministic geometric association tracker for the sparse irregularly-timed keyframes media.decompose #32 emits -- scene-boundary HARD separation (death_reason scene_boundary; scenes from per-frame scene_index and/or a scenes[] list in the #32 seconds shape; absent -> warn + conservative max gap), elapsed-TIME aging (max_gap_ms OR max_missed_samples, integer ms; frame_index is provenance only; per-frame timestamps REQUIRED), exact-class matching, two association tiers (quantized-integer IoU >= threshold; else a TIGHTLY-GATED normalized-centroid fallback ONLY at integer IoU == 0 with elapsed, displacement-allowance and cross-multiplied area-ratio gates; IoU edges STRICTLY outrank fallback edges), deterministic GLOBAL per-class-per-scene assignment via a pinned integer-cost Hungarian in pure PowerShell with the CONTRACT tie rule (lexicographically smallest (track_id, detection_rank) list), fixed-point throughout (milli-pixel boxes, millionth scores, ms timestamps; no sqrt/float-epsilon/NaN). Emits the richer canonical track schema video.timeline #21 consumes (lifeorch.track.objects/0.2: file metadata + identity_scope + tracker_params + input_digest, a samples[] manifest of EVERY processed sample, termination reasons, SEPARATED detection vs association evidence, per-link association records, first-class gap records -- never fabricated coast boxes) as CANONICAL JSON (sorted keys, compact, integers, one trailing LF) split from a diagnostics envelope; sha256(tracks.json) is cross-environment reproducible. -Mode greedy: the i17 baseline greedy-IoU tracker RETAINED BYTE-IDENTICAL (regression oracle / debug path; frame-count coast/age-out; the 0.1 tracks.json). No model, no CUDA, no loopback port, no randomness -> CPU-only, parallel_safe:true, byte-identical for identical input in both modes. Decoupled from live detection (reads a JSON file or inline frames; live #32 -> #16 -> #33 composition is a named follow-on). SCHEMA_NOTES.md records every digest interpretation.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path>; -Mode stable|greedy (default stable); -IouThreshold <0..1> (default 0.3, both modes); -MinScore <double >=0>; -Classes <name,...>. STABLE mode: -MaxGapMs <int ms, default 5000>; -MaxMissedSamples <int, default 3>; -NoSceneMaxGapMs <int ms, default 2000> (conservative cap when scene info is absent); -CentroidBaseAllowance/-CentroidAllowancePerSecond/-CentroidMaxAllowance <double, defaults 0.25/0.25/1.0> (normalized squared-displacement allowance, quantized to millionths); -MaxAreaRatio <double >=1, default 4.0>; -LowConfidenceThreshold <0..1, default 0.5>; -ScenesFile <path> (a #32 scenes.json or bare scene array); -FrameWidth/-FrameHeight <int px, together>; -SourceMediaId/-SourceMediaSha256 <string>. GREEDY mode: -MaxAge <int >=0, default 2>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input, mode, frames, scenes, scenes_file, iou_threshold, max_age, min_score, classes, max_gap_ms, max_missed_samples, no_scene_max_gap_ms, centroid_base_allowance, centroid_allowance_per_second, centroid_max_allowance, max_area_ratio, low_confidence_threshold, frame_width, frame_height, source_media_id, source_media_sha256, detector_provenance}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to a JSON detection sequence. Accepted shapes: a bare array of frames, {frames:[...]}, {sequence:[...]}, or a single detect.objects result ({detections:[...]}) treated as one frame. Each frame: {frame|index|frame_index, timestamp_ms|timestamp_s|timestamp, scene_index?, detections:[...]}. STABLE mode requires per-frame timestamps (timestamp_ms integer ms, or timestamp_s seconds rounded half-up); greedy keeps them optional. The doc top level may also carry scenes, frame_width/frame_height, source_media_id, source_media_sha256, detector_provenance. Required unless InputsJson provides 'input' or inline 'frames'.

inputs.name: frames
inputs.description: Inline detection sequence (an alternative to a file), passed via -InputsJson. Same per-frame shape as a file's frames.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Tracker mode: 'stable' (the 0.2.0 deterministic geometric association tracker + richer canonical schema) or 'greedy' (the byte-identical 0.1.0 baseline; regression oracle / debug path).

inputs.name: scenes
inputs.description: Scene list for stable mode: entries {index?, start|start_ms, end?|end_ms?, score?}; 'start'/'end' are SECONDS (the media.decompose #32 shape, rounded half-up to ms). Derived per-sample scene_index = the last entry whose start_ms <= timestamp_ms (before the first entry -> first index - 1). A per-frame explicit scene_index always wins. Precedence: -ScenesFile > InputsJson.scenes > input-doc scenes.

inputs.name: scenes_file
inputs.description: Path to a scenes JSON (a #32 scenes.json artifact, its result subobject, or a bare scene array).

inputs.name: iou_threshold
inputs.description: Minimum IoU (0..1) for a tier-1 association; stable mode compares the millionth-quantized value on integer milli-pixel boxes.

inputs.name: max_gap_ms
inputs.description: STABLE: terminate a track when real elapsed ms since its last observation exceeds this (evaluated at the next sample; death_reason max_gap). Elapsed-time aging per the design review -- never a frame count.

inputs.name: max_missed_samples
inputs.description: STABLE: terminate a track when it has gone unmatched for MORE than this many processed samples of its scene (death_reason max_missed_samples). Whichever of max_gap_ms / max_missed_samples trips first wins.

inputs.name: no_scene_max_gap_ms
inputs.description: STABLE: when NO scene information exists (no per-frame scene_index, no scenes[]), the effective max gap becomes min(max_gap_ms, this) -- the documented conservative fallback -- plus a warning (status partial).

inputs.name: centroid_base_allowance
inputs.description: STABLE tier-2 gate: base allowance for the squared center displacement normalized by the larger-area box's squared diagonal (quantized to integer millionths; compared by cross-multiplication).

inputs.name: centroid_allowance_per_second
inputs.description: STABLE tier-2 gate: allowance growth per second of elapsed gap (floor-divided integer growth), capped by centroid_max_allowance.

inputs.name: centroid_max_allowance
inputs.description: STABLE tier-2 gate: the HARD cap on the time-grown displacement allowance.

inputs.name: max_area_ratio
inputs.description: STABLE tier-2 gate: max(prevArea/newArea, newArea/prevArea) must not exceed this (cross-multiplied integer compare; >= 1).

inputs.name: low_confidence_threshold
inputs.description: STABLE: an observation is low_confidence when its quantized score is below this (unless the input detection carries its own low_confidence flag); feeds score_summary.low_confidence_observation_count.

inputs.name: max_age
inputs.description: GREEDY only: coast frames before death (0 disables coasting). Ignored by stable mode (which ages by elapsed time + missed samples).

inputs.name: min_score
inputs.description: Drop detections whose score is present and below this floor before association (stable compares quantized). 0 keeps everything.

inputs.name: classes
inputs.description: Optional class-name filter (e.g. [person, car]); only detections of these classes are tracked. Matching is always exact-class regardless of this filter.

inputs.name: frame_width
inputs.description: STABLE: source frame width in pixels (with frame_height); boxes are clipped to the half-open [0,W)x[0,H) source rect in milli-pixel space and the dims are recorded in the canonical file.

inputs.name: frame_height
inputs.description: STABLE: source frame height in pixels (with frame_width).

inputs.name: source_media_id
inputs.description: STABLE: optional source-media identifier recorded in the canonical file (identity_scope = source_media+scene+tracker_invocation).

inputs.name: source_media_sha256
inputs.description: STABLE: optional source-media content hash recorded in the canonical file.

inputs.name: detector_provenance
inputs.description: STABLE: optional detector provenance (e.g. {model_id, label_map_sha256}) recorded verbatim (integers preserved; non-integral numbers stored as strings) in the canonical file.

outputs.description: STABLE (default): { mode:'stable', canonical:<the full lifeorch.track.objects/0.2 canonical doc>, canonical_path, canonical_sha256, diagnostics_path }. The canonical doc: file-level {schema, tracker_version, algorithm, source_media_id?, source_media_sha256?, frame_width?, frame_height?, coordinate_space, box_format, box_unit:'milli_pixel', score_unit:'millionths', timestamp_unit:'ms', identity_scope, detector_provenance?, tracker_params, input_digest, samples[{sample_index,frame_index,timestamp_ms,scene_index,detection_count}], tracks[], summary}; track {track_id, scene_index, class_id, class, first/last_frame_index, start/end/duration_ms, observation_count, spanned_sample_count, gap_count, termination{reason:max_gap|max_missed_samples|scene_boundary|end_of_input, last_observed_ms, terminated_at_ms, missed_samples_at_termination}, score_summary{mean/min/max_detection_score_q, low_confidence_observation_count, scored_observation_count}, association_summary{iou_link_count, centroid_link_count, reacquisition_count, mean/weakest_link_quality_q, maximum_gap_ms}, observations[{sample_index, frame_index, timestamp_ms, detection_index, box{x,y,width,height in milli-px}, detection_score, low_confidence, association{kind:birth|iou|centroid, previous_frame_index, gap_ms, missed_samples, iou_q, normalized_center_distance_q, area_ratio_q}}], gaps[{after/before_sample_index, start/end/elapsed_ms, missed_samples, reacquired_by}]}. tracks.json = the canonical bytes (sorted keys, compact, integers only, one trailing LF; sha256 reproducible across machines); diagnostics.json carries every volatile field. NO aggregate confidence; no quality_score emitted (components are auditable; see SCHEMA_NOTES.md). GREEDY: the 0.1.0 result shape byte-identical ({input, params, summary, tracks[{track_id,class,class_id,frames[],first_frame,last_frame,length,aged_out}]}).
